translationRepairs: Poor, he hired out to the county and became a village head.
Poor, he served the county as a village head.
給事縣為亭長 means he served the county as village head, not that he hired himself out and then became one.
Overjoyed, Wu Han forged Guangwu's seal, drafted a proclamation for Yuyang, sent the student to Peng Chong with county corroboration, then slipped in behind.
Overjoyed, Wu Han forged Guangwu's letter, drafted a proclamation for Yuyang, sent the student to Peng Chong with county corroboration, then slipped in behind.
詐為光武書 is a forged letter of Guangwu, not a forged seal.
They repeatedly recommended one another; when he obtained audience, he then was seen as intimate and trusted and was kept at the gate as favorite.
They repeatedly recommended him; when he obtained audience, he then was seen as intimate and trusted and was kept at the gate as favorite.
數相薦舉 here means they recommended Wu Han, not that the generals recommended one another; the next clause is his audience.
Miao Zeng thought him unarmed and rode out to greet him; Wu Han sprang his horse, seized and executed Miao Zeng, and took his command.
Miao Zeng thought him unarmed and rode out to greet him; Wu Han deployed his armored cavalry, seized and executed Miao Zeng, and took his command.
撝兵騎 is deploying armored cavalry, not springing a horse.
The stray closing quotation mark is not in the Chinese 躬曰：『善。』 and leaves the English sentence broken.
The court sealed him marquis of Guangping with four counties' revenue.
The emperor sent an envoy with sealed orders making him marquis of Guangping with four counties' revenue.
帝使使者璽書 is the emperor sending an envoy with a sealed document, not an impersonal court.
He next cleared the western hills around Ye and the stockades at Xiuwu in Henei.
He next cleared the western hills around Ye, including Li Boqing, and the stockades at Xiuwu in Henei.
The Chinese names the bandit leader 黎伯卿, whom the idiomatic English omits.
He cleared Zhang Zhi in Qinghe and the Wuli bandits in Pingyuan.
He cleared Chang Zhi in Qinghe and the Wuli bandits in Pingyuan.
長直 is the name Chang Zhi, not Zhang Zhi; 張 is a different character.
North he struck the chief of Qinghe Zhang Zhi and the bandits of Wuli in Pingyuan; all were pacified.
North he struck Chang Zhi of Qinghe and the bandits of Wuli in Pingyuan; all were pacified.
清河長直 is one man, Chang Zhi of Qinghe, not a chief of Qinghe named Zhang Zhi.
In winter Han led grand general who establishes might Geng Yan, Hanzhong general Wang Chang, and others, and struck the Fuping and Huosuo two bandits at Pingyuan.
In winter Han led grand general who establishes might Geng Yan, general of Han loyalty Wang Chang, and others, and struck the Fuping and Huosuo two bandits at Pingyuan.
漢忠將軍 is general of Han loyalty, not a Hanzhong general; 漢中 would be Hanzhong.
The east pacified, he marched the army home to Luoyang.
The east pacified, he marched the army home to the capital.
京師 is the capital. The idiomatic English adds Luoyang, which this unit does not name.
The stray closing quotation mark is not in 諸將皆曰『諾』 and breaks the sentence.
Wu Han was iron-hard; on campaign he paced uneasily until the emperor felt secure.
Wu Han was iron-hard; whenever he was on campaign and the emperor was not yet at ease, he stood on the edge of his feet to speak.
帝未安，恒側足而言 means Wu Han stood anxiously while the emperor was not yet at ease, not that Wu Han paced until the emperor felt secure.
He routed Zhou Jian and Su Mao at Pengcheng; they fled to Dong Xian while Fen Xiu surrendered Lanting to the Han.
He routed Zhou Jian and Su Mao at Pengcheng; they fled to Dong Xian while Fen Xiu surrendered Lanting.
舉蘭陵城降 does not name Han. The idiomatic English adds 'to the Han'.
